run_tridentnet_training: run the TridentNet training script with a config file and GPU count via command line
run_tridentnet_evaluation: run the TridentNet model in eval_only mode to evaluate on a COCO dataset
build_trainer_evaluator: build a COCOEvaluator for the Trainer class to evaluate detection results on a dataset
setup_tridentnet_config: setup and merge TridentNet config from a file and command line options then freeze it
resume_and_train: resume a previous TridentNet training checkpoint and continue training the model
